title: Tech Note: Integrating the YUI DataTable with the 4D Ajax Framework Data Bridge

historical_commentary.text: A snapshot of the late-2000s JavaScript ecosystem, when Yahoo's YUI library was a mainstream choice for rich web widgets; both YUI (discontinued by Yahoo in 2014) and the 4D Ajax Framework it integrates with here are long defunct, making this note interesting mainly as a historical record of that era's web-integration patterns.
related_updates: Yahoo officially discontinued the YUI Library in 2014
4D Ajax Framework (4DAF) has also been discontinued; modern 4D web integrations use REST/ORDA with any current JS framework, or Qodly Studio's built-in components
